intro: Smoldering Embers are the glowing, heat-baked remnants retrieved from the raging fire elementals of the Charred Vale. Night elf Sentinels track these cinders as physical proof that the fiery terrors overrunning the devastated woodland are being subdued.

p: The Venture Company's relentless clear-cutting and industrial devastation tore through the Charred Vale, setting the forest ablaze and unleashing destructive fury from deep within the earth. In their wake, elementals of living fire—Burning Ravagers, Burning Destroyers, and wandering Rogue Flame Spirits—surged across the scorched basin. These Smoldering Embers are the lingering, ash-covered cores left behind when an elemental is extinguished, serving as proof that the rampant fires of the vale are being systematically suppressed.
